logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. It's always the water.

panels.composition: The seawall bench in phosphor-green wireframe on a bay drawn as a grid, empty, the title in wireframe capitals over it with the first two words shaded solid and the third still an outline, a progress bar under the title three-quarters full; the town behind as a few wire boxes.
